units.source_text: “这不正好是赤穗义士 [1] 吗？

en.t: Isn't this just like the Forty-seven Ronin [1]?

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，应付这四五十人也实在滑稽……

en.t: Thinking back on it now, dealing with those forty or fifty people really was absurd...

units.source_text: 大家笑了，说这些人都要闹相思病了。”

en.t: Everyone laughed and said that all of them were going to fall sick with lovesickness.
